fields.name: searchKeyword
fields.description: Search keyword, translate to the corresponding country's language whenever possible. Max length 1000 characters

fields.name: country
fields.description: Country site, default US. Options (13 total): US, UK, DE, CA, JP, FR, ES, IT, MX, AU, AE, BR, SA

fields.name: asins
fields.description: ASIN filter list, comma-separated; if not provided, returns all ASINs for this keyword. Max length 1000 characters

fields.name: condition
fields.description:
Condition filter, only one at a time.
Flag type: nfPosition (natural traffic keyword), isSpAd (SP ad keyword), isVedioAd (video ad keyword), isBrandAd (brand ad keyword), isPPCAd (PPC ad keyword), isSearchRecommend (search recommendation keyword), acAd (SP recommendation)
Period count type: totalPeriod.in (new incoming traffic keywords), nfKeywordCnt.total / .in, adKeywordCnt.total / .in, allSpKeywordCnt.total / .in, spKeywordCnt.total / .in, recSpKeywordCnt.total / .in, allSbKeywordCnt.total / .in, sbKeywordCnt.total / .in, sbvKeywordCnt.total / .in

fields.name: last7d
fields.description: Whether to get last 7 days data, default true. When false, use startDate/endDate range

fields.name: startDate
fields.description: Start date yyyy-MM-dd (effective when last7d=false; if omitted, the latest system full week is used)

fields.name: sortBy
fields.description: Sort field. Options: totalKeywordNum (all traffic keywords), naturalKeywordNum (natural traffic keywords), brandKeywordNum (brand ad keywords), vedioKeywordNum (video ad keywords), acKeywordNum (AC recommended keywords), erKeywordNum (ER recommended keywords), trKeywordNum (TR recommended keywords), sumScore (total keyword exposure score), totalNfScore, totalSpSocre (note spelling), totalBrandScore, totalVedioScore, totalAcScore, totalTrScore, totalErScore

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Results per page, min 10, max 100, default 100

fields.name: desc
fields.description: Whether to sort descending, default true
